title: Clip launch gestures
contract: The triangular clip button requests playback; selecting a clip by name then Enter also launches it, and arrows move to neighboring clips. Grid position does not prescribe playback order. Launch mode/quantization arithmetic remains owned by SPEC-CLIP-LAUNCH and SPEC-PLAYBACK-CORE.

title: Clip stop and deactivate contexts
contract: Square Clip Stop controls exist in slots and Track Status. Pressing 0 on selected Session clips deactivates those clips. Stopping a Session clip leaves global Play highlighted and song position advancing. Reactivation/toggle policy is not stated here.

title: Global double Stop
contract: Pressing the Control Bar Stop button twice stops playback of the whole Set and returns Arrangement Position to 1.1.1. Single-stop/continue arithmetic remains in transport/playback contracts.

title: Session clip metadata entrypoints
contract: Session Edit/context Rename and Edit Info Text dispatch to the selected clips; the clip context also exposes its color palette. Shared rename/annotation/color behavior, multi-selection title presentation and the audio-source-name invariant are owned by SPEC-CLIP-VIEW-WORKFLOWS REQ-CLIP-VIEW-004/005. This requirement owns only the Session entrypoints and selection context; text grammar, maximum lengths and multi-selection naming conflicts remain unknown.

title: Grid selection and moving
contract: Drag/drop moves clips in the grid. Shift or platform Ctrl/Cmd supports multi-clip selection before dragging; dragging from an empty slot can rubber-band select. The introductory paragraph names Ctrl without a platform qualifier; platform-specific modifier interpretation remains uncertain outside the explicitly qualified grid paragraph.

title: Group slots
contract: A group slot is shaded when contained tracks have at least one clip in that scene, using the left-most clip color. Its launch control launches the corresponding clips; a group slot with no corresponding clips has a stop control. Clicking a group slot selects the referred clips.

title: Track clip exclusivity
contract: A Session track plays only one clip at a time; alternative material belongs in that track's column. Voice tails, instruments and routed audio are not an extra clip playback instance.

title: Track width gestures
contract: Drag title-bar edges to resize Session tracks; Alt on Windows or Option on Mac while resizing one track resizes all Session tracks. Narrow presentation retains clip launch and essential track controls; minimum size and exact pixel layout are unknown.

title: Track-header deactivation
contract: With a Session track header selected, 0 deactivates that track. This context differs from selected-clip deactivation; the manual does not specify an activation toggle or selection precedence with a text editor focused.

title: Scene launch and cancellation
contract: A Scene Launch control in the Main-track column launches the clips in its row together. Cancel Scene Launch in the Main-track context menu cancels a previously triggered scene launch. Exact cancellation deadline and already-committed launch behavior are unknown.

title: Next-scene selection preference
contract: After a scene launch the scene below is selected as the next to launch unless Select Next Scene on Launch in Launch Settings is Off. Last-scene wrap/creation, empty scenes and concurrent selection edits are unknown.

title: Scene metadata commands
contract: Scene Rename is available in Edit/context menus and Tab can advance through successive scene renames. Edit Info Text supplies annotation; a context palette supplies color. Scene View title context also offers Rename/color for one or multiple selected scenes. Multi-scene naming transformation and platform/focus preferences remain unknown.

title: Scene ordering and position numbers
contract: Scene drag/drop reorders rows. Shift-click selects adjacent scenes; Ctrl-click selects nonadjacent scenes in the retained text. Dragging nonadjacent scenes collapses them together; Ctrl+Up/Down moves them without collapsing. Scene numbers reflect current row position rather than stable identity. OS modifier substitution and boundary behavior are unknown.

title: Scene tempo/meter editing
contract: Dragging the Main-title left edge reveals scene tempo/meter controls, documented hidden by default. Values can be dragged or typed then Enter, and edited in Scene View. Launching a scene with assigned values adjusts project tempo/meter. This is a Version12 documentary claim; target storage and scheduler behavior remain separate.

title: Scene documented numeric domain
contract: The captured manual permits scene tempo20-999 BPM and meter numerator1-99 with denominator1,2,4,8,16. These are documentary UI domains, not a replacement for SPEC-TRANSPORT-STATE's narrower evidence on numeric storage, parsing or scheduling.

title: Disable/reset scene assignments
contract: An enabled scene tempo/meter control can be disabled and reset with Return to Default or Delete; double-click disables it. The reset stored numeric value and retention on double-click are not supplied.

title: Scene keyboard traversal
contract: Left/right arrows navigate from selected slots/scenes to tempo/meter controls. Within scene name/tempo/meter editing, Tab/Shift-Tab advances/reverses controls and crosses to the next/previous scene at row ends. Enter on a selected tempo/meter control first selects the scene; a second Enter launches it. Keyboard accessibility preference/context interactions remain unproven.

title: Scene assignment indicator
contract: A scene with assigned tempo and/or meter change has a colored Scene Launch button. The captured text supplies no exact color, contrast, accessibility label or mapping from scene custom color.

title: Pre-Live11 scene-name migration
contract: For Sets made before Live11 with tempo/meter in scene names, the manual describes carrying those values into scene controls on opening newer Live and widening Main to expose them. Exact legacy grammar, build boundary, malformed-name handling and migration round trips remain unknown.

title: Scene View selection context
contract: Selecting one/multiple scenes, clicking a scene tempo/meter control, or clicking Main title opens Scene View. Its top edits tempo/meter; lower controls expose scene Follow Actions, whose execution belongs to the launch owner. For one selected scene its title shows name/number/color if assigned; multiple scenes show selection count.

title: Track Status presentation
contract: Looping clips show a pie chart with right-side loop length in beats and left-side number of played loops. A playing group shows a pie without numbers. One-shots show progress and remaining minutes:seconds. Monitored audio/MIDI show microphone/keyboard icons; Arrangement playback shows a miniature Arrangement. Overlapping status precedence and update rounding are unknown.

title: Multi-file import layout
contract: Browser import or recording can populate Session. Multiple raw audio/MIDI files default to one Session column; Ctrl on Windows or Cmd on Mac before drop spreads them over tracks. This multi-track drop shortcut does not apply to Live Clips with embedded devices. Media decoding and recording remain in their owners.

title: Select on Launch preference
contract: Clip launch normally selects the clip for Clip View. Turning off Select on Launch in Launch Settings lets the current view/focus remain when clips or scenes launch. This preference is separate from Select Next Scene on Launch.

title: Stop-button editing
contract: Edit Add/Remove Stop Button adds/removes grid Clip Stop controls. Removing an empty row/track stop control permits scene launch without affecting that track. Launch scheduling and empty armed-slot recording policy remain owned by launch/recording contracts.

title: Insert Scene
contract: Create Insert Scene inserts an empty scene below the current selection. Multi-selection anchor, selection after insert and scene count limits are unknown.

title: Capture and Insert Scene
contract: Create Capture and Insert Scene inserts below current selection, copies currently running clips into it and launches it. The manual claims no audible interruption; this packet supplies no signal comparator or timing tolerance for that claim. Scene capture is distinct from Capture MIDI and Arrangement Record.

title: Cross-view clip transfer
contract: Copy/paste and drag permit Session/Arrangement clip transfer, including across separate windows. Arrangement-to-Session paste attempts matching top-to-bottom temporal ordering. Exact tiling, overlaps, metadata transfer and operation atomicity are unknown. Keyboard Second Window controls retain their OS-specific documented modifiers.

title: Consolidate Time to New Scene
contract: Arrangement Create/context Consolidate Time to New Scene makes one new clip per selected track from the selected time and places them in a new Session scene below prior selected scene. Audio tracks containing at least one selected clip generate new samples. The signal/destination contract for audio consolidation stays in REQ-ARRANGEMENT-010; exact silence-only, MIDI merge and file-failure behavior remain unknown.

title: Lifecycle and boundary outcomes
contract: Required operational outcomes below remain unknown; documentary gestures and XML structure do not establish them.
